newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian July-Sept coffee output seen off sharply.
newsitem.headline: Colombian July-Sept coffee output seen off sharply.

text.p: BOGOTA, June 5 Reuter - Colombia's July-Sept coffee output is expected to be no more than 1.5 million 60-kg bags, well below average production of 900,000 bags per month, the National Coffee Growers' Federation said late Thursday.

To help make up for the expected shortfall and allow Colombia to export 2.5 million 60-kg bags during the three-month period, the federation plans to release up to one million bags of old crop coffee from its inventories for sale abroad, it said in a statement.
The statement also confirmed an announcement earlier this week by Finance Minister Jose Antonio Ocampo, who said no limits would be placed on July and August coffee registrations.

"In view of the fact that the size of the Colombian coffee crop is inferior to export plans for the July-September quarter of the current year, the National Coffee Growers' Federation will open registrations for sales by private exporters without any limitation in the months of July and August," the statement said.
It did not specify when registrations would actually open, however.
